tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Clairaut's equation] ↗ def:complete-integral 1. ch3:3.1-ex-1\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

For $x\cdot Du+f(Du)=u$, the functions \[ u(x,a)=a\cdot x+f(a),\qquad a\in \R ^n, \] form a complete integral. \end{example}
